mapper.select:
select DJ_RESULTMGID,PARTYNAME,PARTYCODE,RESULTNAME,substr(SCORETEXT,1,10) as scoreText,SCORETIME from dj_resultmg where OPERATESTATE in ('A','M')
and PARTYCODE like concat('%',#{partyCode},'%')
and RESULTNAME like concat('%',#{name},'%')
and SCORETIME >= date_format(#{beginTime},'%Y%m%d')
and SCORETIME <= date_format(#{endTime},'%Y%m%d')
and SUBSTR(PARTYCODE,1,12) in(select DZZDM from ZZ_DZZFBQK where ZZFB= #{zzfbType})
order by CREATETIME desc

select bd.BRANDID,bd.PARTYNAME,bd.PARTYCODE,bd.PBRANDNAME,bd.CREATTYPE,bd.BRANDTIME,FILEID,FILENAME from dj_brand bd left join CF_FILE fl on bd.BRANDID=fl.FILEREFID where bd.OPERATESTATE in ('A','M')
and bd.PARTYCODE like concat('%',#{partyCode},'%')
and bd.PBRANDNAME like concat('%',#{pbrandName},'%')
and bd.CREATTYPE = #{creatType}
and bd.BRANDTIME >= date_format(#{beginTime},'%Y%m%d')
and bd.BRANDTIME <= date_format(#{endTime},'%Y%m%d')
and SUBSTR(bd.PARTYCODE,1,12) in(select DZZDM from ZZ_DZZFBQK where ZZFB= #{zzfbType})
order by bd.CREATETIME desc

select PARTYACTIVITYROOMID,PARTYNAME,PARTYCODE,ADDR,PCOUNT,USERANGE,USEAREA from dj_partyActivityRoom where OperateState in ('A','M')
and PARTYCODE like concat('%',#{partyCode},'%')
and ADDR like concat('%',#{addr},'%')
and USERANGE = #{useRange}
and SUBSTR(PARTYCODE,1,12) in(select DZZDM from ZZ_DZZFBQK where ZZFB= #{zzfbType})
order by CREATETIME desc

select WXGROUPID,PARTYNAME,PARTYCODE,GROUPNAME,BUILDTIME,IMPLATFORM,GROUPERNAME,SCALENUMBER,UPDATETIME, (select count(1) from dj_wxGroupUser gu where gu.WXGROUPID=g.WXGROUPID) as groupCount from dj_wxGroup g where OperateState in ('A','M')
and PARTYCODE like concat('%',#{partyCode},'%')
and PARTYNAME like concat('%',#{partyName},'%')
and GROUPNAME like concat('%',#{groupName},'%')
and IMPLATFORM = #{implatform}
and GROUPERNAME like concat('%',#{grouperName},'%')
and BUILDTIME >= date_format(#{beginTime},'%Y%m%d')
and BUILDTIME <= date_format(#{endTime},'%Y%m%d')
and SUBSTR(partyCode,1,12) in(select DZZDM from ZZ_DZZFBQK where ZZFB= #{zzfbType})
and SCALENUMBER >= #{scaleBegin}
and SCALENUMBER <= #{scaleEnd}

select WXGROUPUSERID,WXGROUPID,USERNAME,SEX,MOBILE from dj_wxGroupUser where OPERATESTATE in ('A','M')
and WXGROUPID = #{wxGroupId}
